title: Playwright Self-Healing Test Automation Framework
subtitle: Custom Dynamic Selector Healing & Automated Test Resilience
problem: Frequent web application UI updates and dynamic DOM elements at INTO Global caused brittle locators to break, consuming significant QA engineering bandwidth to manually debug and update selectors.
solution: Engineered a custom Playwright self-healing test automation framework from scratch with intelligent DOM inspection and fallback selector strategies. Automatically resolves broken selectors at runtime and cuts locator maintenance time by 80%.
architecture: Playwright TS Suite -> DOM Selector Interceptor -> Dynamic Self-Healing Engine -> Auto-Resolved Selector -> Test Report

title: Fire TV RTU Testing Tool & Android ADB Performance Suite
subtitle: Automated Installation, Startup Latency & SIM Ticket Bot
problem: Manual RTU (Ready-to-Use) testing on Fire TV devices took 50 minutes per cycle, while SIM ticket resolution required 30 minutes per manual ticket.
solution: Developed an RTU device testing tool for Fire TV using Python ADB, reducing manual testing time by 80% (from 50m to 10m). Built an automated SIM Ticket Bot reducing resolution time to 1 minute per ticket with 99% accuracy.
architecture: Jenkins Controller -> Python ADB Bridge -> Fire TV / Android Device Farm -> Automated Latency Logcat Metrics

title: Automated Test Evidence Capture Tool
subtitle: Automated QA Screenshot, Video & Execution Log Recording Engine
problem: Manual test evidence collection (capturing screenshots, recording logs, and organizing test artifacts per app) at Amazon Appstore limited QA testing throughput to 8 apps per day and created verification delays.
solution: Engineered an automated Test Evidence Capturing Tool using Python ADB and Java to capture high-resolution screenshots, video recordings, and Logcat traces automatically during execution, doubling QA app throughput to 16 apps per day.
architecture: Jenkins Pipeline -> ADB Video/Logcat Engine -> Automated Screenshot Sampler -> Evidence Artifact Packager -> QA Report

title: YouTube Shorts Gesture Control Engine
subtitle: Real-Time OpenCV & MediaPipe Hand Tracking Automation
problem: Navigating YouTube Shorts hands-free while cooking, exercising, or multitasking is inconvenient with physical mouse and keyboard inputs.
solution: Engineered a real-time computer vision gesture control engine using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe to detect hand gestures via webcam and trigger automated play/pause, scroll, and volume controls for YouTube Shorts.
architecture: Webcam Stream -> MediaPipe Landmark Detection -> Gesture Classifier -> PyAutoGUI Control Engine -> YouTube Shorts
